newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rugby union-Canterbury thumps Queensland 48-3.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Canterbury thumps Queensland 48-3.

text.p: The Canterbury Crusaders ended their Super 12 rugby campaign with a crushing 48-3 win over the Queensland Reds at Lancaster Park on Saturday.
The victory, which included six tries without reply, was not enough to lift the Crusaders fifth or sixth into next week's tournament semifinals.
The Crusaders earned their convincing victory after wing Daryl Gibson and halfback Justin Marshall scored thrilling tries in the first half to set up a runaway in the final stages.
